spending_entity: Fonds de service universel de télécommunications
programme: Fonds de service universel de télécommunications
line_name: Fonds de service universel de télécommunications
purpose: The telecommunications universal-service fund: connectivity programmes (4G and broadband coverage, satellite links) and contributions to the state's digital projects.
scope_basis: A special Treasury account whose statutory object is universal telecommunications service; every programme it reports funding is connectivity or a digital public system, so the account is held whole.
amount_scale: dirhams, printed in full units (En dirhams); stored as printed
doc_locator: Loi de finances n° 50-25 (BO n° 7465 bis, Arabic general edition), Tableau ز (article 47), expenditure of the special Treasury accounts, PDF p. 101, compte 3.2.0.0.1.04.005, column expenditure for the year 2026
notes: Own-source: the fund is fed by operators' universal-service contributions (the settlement bill records 397,472,449.23 of receipts in 2024). Its reported commitments include the national population register (about 300 MDH, a contribution to the Interior line held separately), a digital-transformation roadmap paid to the Agence de Développement du Digital, emergency-call renewal, a secure high-speed state network, the national administration portal and the 4G and very-high-speed coverage programmes (report on the special Treasury accounts, PLF 2026, section 2.4.4). Receiving bodies are not held. Fetched copies match OSINT's artefact index by md5 (lf2026 f103fc6b). Reconciliation: the 57 CAS lines of the law's table sum to its printed CAS total, 154,473,586,000. The figure was read off the rendered page of the Arabic general edition.

spending_entity: Fonds spécial pour la mise en place des titres identitaires électroniques et des titres de voyage
programme: Fonds spécial pour la mise en place des titres identitaires électroniques et des titres de voyage
line_name: Fonds spécial pour la mise en place des titres identitaires électroniques et des titres de voyage
purpose: Pays for the electronic national identity card and travel documents: card production systems, PKI, biometric identification and their maintenance, for the national police directorate.
scope_basis: A special Treasury account whose statutory object is setting up electronic identity and travel documents; the mandate is wholly identity infrastructure.
amount_scale: dirhams, printed in full units (En dirhams); stored as printed
doc_locator: Loi de finances n° 50-25 (BO n° 7465 bis, Arabic general edition), Tableau ز (article 47), expenditure of the special Treasury accounts, PDF p. 101, compte 3.2.0.0.1.08.010, column expenditure for the year 2026
notes: Own-source: the fund is fed by identity and travel-document fees (the settlement bill records 689,326,975.15 of receipts in 2024). Its 2024 spending named in the report on the special Treasury accounts (PLF 2026, section 2.6.6) is the CNIE card solution 210.62 MDH, the PKI platform 54.54, AFIS and facial recognition 16.85, the police data-centre upkeep 12.00, identity-management maintenance 23.38 and IT equipment 21.23, and also 150.09 MDH of office furniture for the police headquarters; the account is held whole by its mandate, and the furniture is named here because it is inside the 2024 outturn. Fetched copies match OSINT's artefact index by md5 (lf2026 f103fc6b). Reconciliation: the 57 CAS lines of the law's table sum to its printed CAS total, 154,473,586,000. The figure was read off the rendered page of the Arabic general edition.

line_name: Fonds de modernisation de l'administration publique, d'appui à la transition numérique et à l'utilisation de l'amazighe
purpose: The digital ministry's special account for public-administration modernisation, the digital transition and the use of Amazigh in administration.
scope_basis: The account's three programmes are public-service modernisation, the digital transition and the use of Amazigh; the appropriation is one ceiling for all three, so the digital part cannot be separated at the stage appropriated.
amount_scale: dirhams, printed in full units (En dirhams); stored as printed
doc_locator: Loi de finances n° 50-25 (BO n° 7465 bis, Arabic general edition), Tableau ز (article 47), expenditure of the special Treasury accounts, PDF p. 102, compte 3.2.0.0.1.33.001, column expenditure for the year 2026
notes: Its resources are not itemised in the documents read, so the funding source is unstated. The report on the special Treasury accounts (PLF 2026, section 2.6.8) splits the 2024 outturn of 837.47 MDH as digital economy 501.25, digital inclusion 202.14, digital administration 61.57, Amazigh 70.90 and public-service modernisation 1.61, so about nine tenths of the 2024 spending was digital; the split exists only for the outturn and is not used to divide the appropriation.
